question: Which of the following was authored by Harisenacharya?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brihatkatha Kosh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Brihatkatha Kosh** was authored by Harisenacharya.
 
• The work is significant in the genre of Sanskrit literature.
 
• It is considered one of the important texts in classical Indian narratives.
 
• Harisenacharya's contribution through this work provides insights into the cultural and social aspects of his time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajatarangini**

 
 
• Authored by Kalhana, it is a historical chronicle of the north-western Indian subcontinent, particularly the kings of Kashmir.
 
 
 
• **Brihat Katha Manjari**
 
 
• Written by Kshemendra, it is an abridged version of the Brihatkatha, a large collection of stories attributed to Gunadhya.
 
 
 
• **Lilavati**
 
 
• A treatise on mathematics written by the Indian mathematician Bhaskara II, which deals with arithmetic, algebra, and geometry.
 
 
 
• **Sanskrit Literature**
 
 
• Is one of the oldest literatures in the world, consisting of a vast body of texts in the Sanskrit language.
 
• Includes a wide range of works such as epics, hymns, philosophical treatises, poetry, drama, and scientific texts.
 
• Important texts include the Vedas, Upanishads, Mahabharata, Ramayana, and various other Shastras.
